connector.name: Oddsockets
connector.registryDescription: Agent-first real-time messaging: pub/sub, presence, history. 12 tools over SSE, self-provision.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.oddsockets.ai over server sent events. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your OddSockets API key: 'Bearer ak_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-provision an app via the oddsockets_signup tool.
